blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: referential integrity — Foreign keys refer to valid rows.

blocks.title: Understand
blocks.text: Data capture gathers data, while validation, verification and referential integrity address different correctness concerns.

blocks.title: Trace
blocks.text: Atomicity ensures a transaction is all-or-nothing; consistency preserves constraints; isolation addresses concurrent interference; durability keeps committed results.

blocks.title: Explain
blocks.text: Row locking, transactions and appropriate constraints help prevent two concurrent changes from corrupting financial or stock records.

blocks.title: Worked example · Predict
blocks.text: Both writes must succeed together or be undone so stock does not change without a valid order.
